name: Tsuge Eufinley
source:
The boss of the Tsuge Divine Music Player Office. She plays a violin-like instrument and is very strict. She has a contract with two spirits, Yardio and Mashat, the latter of whom is seldom seen.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Shinkyoku_S%C5%8Dkai_Polyphonica_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
